focus.product: Production tooling for car and motorcycle lines: press dies, jigs and checking fixtures
focus.why: Jakarta holds the OEMs that buy tooling (Toyota TMMIN Sunter II, Astra Daihatsu, Astra Honda, Honda Prospect, Yamaha and Suzuki in Cakung, Mitsubishi Krama Yudha). Tooling and CNC-machine capacity already exists: Waja Kamajaya Sentosa makes dies, jigs and fixtures, and Garuda Otomasi and Astra Otoparts hold TKDN for CNC machines. Indonesia imported US$68.4M of HS 8207.30 press tools in 2024. Jakarta's UMP of Rp5.73M is the highest minimum wage in Indonesia, so it fits low-volume, engineering-heavy work. The RPIP 2026-2046 targets high-tech industry and industrial services. CNC and EDM do the core work; 3D printing helps on fixture nests and gauges.

also.product: Gears, differential cases, axles and propeller shafts
also.why: Asano Gear (600,000 differential units/yr), Morita Tjokro Gearindo and Inti Ganda Perdana (687,600 axle and shaft units) already work in Pegangsaan Dua and Pulogadung. Indonesia imported US$267.2M of HS 8483.40 gears in 2024.

also.product: 3D-printed prototypes, architectural and product models, and low-volume spare parts
also.why: FOMU (70+ machines, Duri Kepa) serves architects, Astra, Pertamina and the PUPR ministry. Jakarta's 2018 industry by-law (Perda 4/2018) prioritises creative industry. This is a service, not a traded good.

skills: Politeknik Astra (ex-Polman Astra) Sunter campus, Jl. Gaya Motor Raya 8, offers D3 Teknik Produksi dan Proses Manufaktur, D3 Pembuatan Peralatan dan Perkakas Produksi (tool making) and Mekatronika. Its main campus moved to Delta Silicon II, Cikarang (opened 22 May 2023). Jakarta Creative Hub ran a makerspace with 3D printers and laser cutters (2017; current status unverified). SMK and BLK CNC seat counts were not found.

focus.product: Moulds for rubber and plastics: tyre, shoe-sole, rubber-part and injection moulds (making and refurbishing)
focus.why: Tangerang hosts many mould users. Gajah Tunggal (tyres), IRC Inoac and Aneka Komkar Utama (8.5 million rubber parts) are in Jatiuwung. Takagi Sari makes injection parts for Astra Daihatsu, Yamaha and Toyota. Stanley makes 4.8 million lamp units, LG has a plant in Legok, and Nike maker Pratama Abadi (2 million pairs/month) is based in Serpong. Indonesia imported US$191.0M (8480.71) plus US$59.0M (8480.79) of such moulds in 2024. Yoska Prima Inti already makes dies, jigs and fixtures. No independent mould shops were verified, so this is a gap to fill. Moulds are cut by CNC and EDM; 3D printing serves sole prototypes and sample moulds.

also.product: Precision motorcycle and car parts: forged and threaded fasteners, pivots, die-cast and machined aluminium parts
also.why: Indoseiki (forging, thread rolling, CNC lathes, IATF 16949), Systema Precision, Dharma Polimetal (1.5 million pcs/yr), Sinar Alum Sarana (die casting plus machining) and Koza Presisi already work here. Buyers include Astra Honda, Yamaha, Astra Daihatsu and Kawasaki.

also.product: Pump, valve and oilfield machined parts: impellers, flanges, valve bodies, OCTG accessories
also.why: Kaiquan Pump (43% TKDN), Arflu Se and Borneo Mandiri (flanges up to 51% TKDN) are here, along with Molden Patra Sejahtera (oilfield accessories up to 87% TKDN) and Central Presisi Metal (OCTG). Indonesia imported US$296.6M of pump parts (8413.91) in 2024.

focus.product: Maintenance spares for steel and petrochemical plants: rolling-mill rolls and roll-shop work, pump impellers and shafts, valve and heat-exchanger parts (reverse-engineered)
focus.why: The Krakatau Steel group and Krakatau Posco make slab, plate, HRC, CRC and pipe here. Chandra Asri (polyethylene), Asahimas (VCM/PVC) and coal power plants form the region's heavy-process base, and all of them consume wear and rotating parts. Indonesia imported US$34.9M of rolls (8455.30) and US$68.4M of rolling-mill parts (8455.90) in 2024, plus US$296.6M of pump parts (8413.91). Fabricators already exist (Daekyung Indah in KIEC, Tuban Steel Work, Timas Suplindo). Politeknik Industri Petrokimia Banten trains machine technicians.

also.product: Gas valves and valve parts: LPG cylinder valves and forged or brass valve bodies
also.why: PT Asa Bintang Pratama (Modern Cikande) holds TKDN of 92.20-97.86% for LPG cylinder valves. This is a fully localised, high-content product line that can be scaled up.

also.product: Shoe-sole moulds for the Serang footwear plants
also.why: Pou Chen Group Indonesia hires a bottom-mould engineer in Serang (2D/3D sole geometry and moulds; the group made 238.3 million pairs last year). Sole moulds are also the core of Tangerang's mould focus.
